claims.claim_text: NVIDIA 自陳冷卻溫度每升 1°C 約省 4% 冷卻能耗，一座 50MW 廠房一年可省超過 400 萬美元
claims.evidence: raising chiller plant temperatures by just one degree can cut cooling energy costs by about 4% ... A 50-megawatt hyperscale facility can save over $4 million annually in cooling-related energy and water costs by moving to liquid-cooled infrastructure.
claims.note: Lede 明確標注為 NVIDIA 自陳；數字在來源 verbatim，4% 帶 'about'/'industry estimates' hedge、$4M 帶 'can save'，lede 用『約』『可省』對應，無膨脹。

claims.claim_text: Rubin 世代改用 100% 液冷、冷卻水溫拉高到 45°C：不只 GPU/CPU，整機所有元件都重新為液冷設計，藉此拿掉風扇、把用水量壓到趨近於零
claims.evidence: The Rubin generation of NVIDIA AI infrastructure is the world's first to achieve 100% liquid cooling — every chip, every networking component, cooled entirely by liquid ... up to 45 degrees Celsius ... no fans anywhere in the system ... reducing facility cooling water consumption ... to near zero
claims.note: 四個子主張皆在來源 verbatim；lede 標注為 NVIDIA 揭露。

claims.claim_text: 作者用一個挑釁的標題主張：把 DNSSEC 當成可有可無，等於替 MITM 攻擊鋪路
claims.note: whynothugo.nl 連續回 HTTP 503（anti-bot，非 404，頁面對人類仍在）；Wayback 對 WebFetch 封鎖。此 lede 為純歸因報導（『作者主張…』『挑釁的標題』），未把 DNSSEC 技術細節當成事實斷言，故 load 評 medium，視覺上已是 hedged attribution。

claims.claim_text: Nub 是一套對標 Bun 的 Node.js 全家桶——把 runtime、bundler、test runner、package 管理收進單一工具鏈
claims.evidence: A fast all-in-one toolkit that augments Node.js instead of replacing it ... A Bun-like DX on top of stock `node`, written in Rust.
claims.note: README 確認 all-in-one toolkit + 明確對標 Bun。README 強調不附自帶 runtime；lede 未宣稱 Nub 自帶 runtime，無膨脹。
Round-1 checker 指出原 lede『以 Show HN 形式亮相』在 GitHub README 無據（item 來源是 repo）。fix loop 已刪除『Show HN』措辭，僅留『仍在早期』作為對一個新公開專案的合理判斷（inferred），不再宣稱無據的出處細節。

claims.claim_text: Aura Frames 在 2025 聖誕節尖峰扛下每小時 4100 萬次 API 請求（約 11.4K req/s），靠的是把單一主資料庫拆成八個
claims.evidence: Christmas 2025 ... serving a peak of 41 million API requests per hour (~11.4K requests per second) ... 8 primary databases in total

claims.claim_text: Rails 7 的 disable_joins:true 把跨表 join 改寫成多條 SELECT；用 physical replication 把唯讀 replica 升格成 writer；尖峰時整個叢集每秒處理 22.6 萬筆交易
claims.evidence: The disable_joins feature replaces SQL joins, issuing multiple SELECT statements ... launched in Rails 7.0 ... use physical replication ... then promote it to become a writer database ... peak transactions per second (TPS) was 226K

claims.claim_text: Slint 釋出 1.17：DragArea/DropArea 拖放、跨平台系統匣、內建 tooltip 與 model row 雙向綁定；Linux/macOS 降低 idle CPU，並為 Android 補上 C++ 支援
claims.evidence: A `DragArea` marks the source ... `SystemTrayIcon` works on macOS, Windows, and Linux ... new `Tooltip` element ... bind directly to model row data ... idle CPU usage drops to near zero (Windows is still pending) ... build Slint apps for Android from a C++ codebase.
claims.note: 全部功能確認；idle CPU 改善 lede 標 Linux/macOS，與來源『Windows is still pending』一致。

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 抽換掉自家核心 OAuth 引擎，把自管 OAuth 開放給所有開發者；切換窗口約三小時，並接受少量寫入在新舊版本交接時遺失
claims.evidence: the upgrade window took approximately three hours ... a way to leave writes to the database enabled, at the cost of losing some of them in the switch to the green version
claims.note: Round-1 判原 lede『零停機遷移』為 inflated/unverifiable（來源明示約 3 小時窗口＋接受少量寫入遺失）。fix loop 已改寫 lede：刪除『零停機』，改述來源真實取捨。改寫後與來源 verbatim 對齊。

claims.claim_text: Microsoft（Agent Experience 系列）：當 AI coding agent 沒見過私有程式碼，會套訓練資料裡最接近的公開技術（把內部 auth library 當成 OAuth）；解法是用 instruction file 明寫『用 mutual TLS、不是 OAuth』、用 MCP server 餵 API 細節、把錯誤訊息寫成教學面；糾正已知技術約 500 token、從零教未知技術要 3000+
claims.evidence: the model defaults to the closest match in its training data ... an instruction file should state it uses mutual TLS with certificates, NOT OAuth ... MCP servers for on-demand API details ... 500 tokens for correcting known tech vs. 3,000+ for bootstrapping unknown tech
claims.note: 原 item-07（Gemma 4 12B laptop）在 fix loop 中被 check-dup 揪出：正確的 developers.googleblog.com URL 已於 2026-06-06 deep-gemma-4-encoder-free 涵蓋過，屬全檔案重複。已替換為 fresh 的 Microsoft Agent Experience 文章（devblogs.microsoft.com，re-fetch 成功）。lede 的具體例子（mutual TLS NOT OAuth）與 token 對比（500 vs 3000+）皆由來源支持。

claims.claim_text: 官方稱在 Artificial Analysis 榜上進前十、在獨立實驗室中排第二，K2 Raw 與 K2 Turbo 權重都已在 Hugging Face 釋出
claims.evidence: Krea 2 is among the top 10 models on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard for text-to-image, and scores 2nd place among models from independent labs. ... Release includes K2 Raw and K2 Turbo open weights
claims.note: verbatim；lede 用『官方稱』歸因排名。

claims.claim_text: Krea 2 用 grouped-query attention、sigmoid-gated attention，文字編碼器接 Qwen 3 VL，並刻意避開 AI 生成圖
claims.evidence: grouped-query attention (GQA), sigmoid-gated attention ... we use Qwen 3 VL as our final text encoder ... we use no AI-generated images in our pretraining mix

claims.claim_text: 有人把 WINE 移植到自製的 hobby OS「Astral」上，目標是在從零寫起的系統上跑 Windows 遊戲
claims.evidence: Porting Wine was a fun challenge and a way of proving that hobby OSes can be used to play a lot more games than originally thought.

claims.claim_text: Google 把 computer use 直接做進 Gemini 3.5 Flash；targeted adversarial training；敏感操作要使用者確認、偵測到 prompt injection 就自動中止；透過 Gemini API 與 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 開放，另有 Browserbase 代管 demo
claims.evidence: Computer use is now a built-in tool supported in Gemini 3.5 Flash ... see, reason and take action across browser, mobile and desktop ... targeted adversarial training ... Require explicit user confirmation for sensitive or irreversible actions ... Automatically stop tasks if an indirect prompt injection is identified ... demo environment hosted by Browserbase.
